optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with OTA firmware releases, HIL testing, release notes, and incident handling for a fleet of public charging stations. No additional claims beyond those documented are made.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware role.

role.roleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

evidence.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of OTA releases and success rate monitoring.

evidence.text: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet‑wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on‑call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.
evidence.notes: Explicit monitoring of success rates and incident handling.

evidence.text: Held the field on‑call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet‑wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on‑call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of on‑call incident handling.

evidence.text: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign‑off.
Tested each firmware version on the hardware‑in‑the‑loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of HIL testing and documented records.

evidence.text: Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand‑over conditions for the field technicians.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of release notes content.
